pretreatments.description: Hydrothermal pretreatment (HP) via autohydrolysis of sugarcane bagasse at 183°C for 41 minutes with a liquid-to-solid ratio (LSR) of 3.94 mL/g, resulting in hemicellulose removal of 73% and cellulose preservation of 82.1%, followed by alkaline extraction (AE) at pH ~3.5 to partially delignify the material.

Advanced oxidative pretreatment (AOP) applied to the alkaline-extracted SB pretreated by HP using hydrogen peroxide (H_2O_2) at various ratios (0.3 to 3.0 g_H_2O_2/g_SB), liquid-to-solid ratios (5 to 25 mL/g_SB), and reaction times (1 to 8 hours) at 25°C, with pH adjusted to 11.6, to achieve further delignification and maximize cellulose and glucose yield.

Enzymatic hydrolysis using Cellic HTec2 and Cellic CTec2 cocktails with sodium azide (0.02%) and LSR of 10 mL/g at 50°C for 72 hours, utilizing residual solid fractions from AOP or HP to produce fermentable sugars.

Anaerobic digestion (AD) of the liquid waste streams generated from AE and AOP pretreatment steps, performed under mesophilic conditions (35°C, 200 rpm) with sufficient food-to-microorganism (F/M) ratio to recover methane for energy balance and treat effluents.
